canonical_fit.scope: One integrated original practical links operating accrual/cash, an incremental SPV and correctly priced claims, a funded institutional mandate, capped protection/credit/settlement and conditional governance. All 60 prerequisite chapters are accepted, but this component samples specified capabilities and does not claim to test every chapter detail.
canonical_fit.distinctness: One original 15-policy production-note/escrow investment contract. No Portlight two-currency/resolution relabel, copied chapter lab, Monte Carlo expansion, unbounded generic trading engine or repeated Form A/B numerical case.

architecture_and_information.original_gate: Root approved the architecture after 61 independent blueprint comparisons; author subsequently implemented the original contract. Root later recomputed all 15 printed policy rows, six event rows and focused transfers without author-model or output oracles.
architecture_and_information.sources_of_cash: Client 288/5 and sponsor 32/5 actually fund Cedar 64; note Cedar plus separate underwriter subscribe 41, new equity holder 9 funds total SPV investment 50. Distinct provider cash budgets and existing dealer claim ownership are explicit. Initial modeled cash total 272 is conserved across listed transfers.
architecture_and_information.dates: All cutoffs 09:00/12:00/16:00 are the same terminal day; entry-to-terminal discount 9/10 and zero intraday carry stipulated. Bills before first client payment; project operating cash/note/escrow before second; late protection only afterward. Subsequent cures preserve the missed deadline.
architecture_and_information.rights: SPV and parent segregated; note first, residual equity second. Surviving note and protection nominal claims remain separately disclosed with zero additional modeled recovery. Segregated pool units are allocated once; premium goes to existing dealer, not writers. Each writer receives idle pool cash only at that pool settlement time.
architecture_and_information.information: Baseline/before-trade selection is prospective. After-trade revenue/priority/delivery shocks retain actual baseline holdings; other policies are historical-entry counterfactuals, not executable switches. institution_approval uses actual unchanged holdings; prospective_entry_approval becomes null. A physical-probability-only revision is a new prospective assessment with unchanged market prices.
architecture_and_information.conservation_limit: External SPV customers and equipment buyer are named stipulated funded payers; their full balance sheets and legacy parent later debt service are outside the model. No whole-economy endowment or real legal/operational availability claim.

Every cell of all 15 policy rows independently recomputed; exactly four are feasible, and the unique winner has x=1/2 and escrow h=1/4. Proof excludes nine untimely no/credit hedges, derives half-escrow x<=46/73 and full-escrow monotonicity. Expected capital 281/36; residual market value 25/4 equals paid-in 32/5 minus fee 3/20. Benchmark 64/9, mean loss -25/36, VaR90 -17/18, atom-adjusted ES90 14/9. Full-performance liability PV 288/5 is not asserted for rejected defaulting portfolios.

All selected cutoff balances, both pool allocations, existing unit ownership and the late-cure counterexample are computed independently. Exact inclusive capital boundary 19/9 precedes payment boundary 55/9; domain and information restrictions are explicit.

Conditional numerical approval versus external evidence/authority, named controller/financing/treasury/risk/committee roles, counterparties and risk bearers, fail-stop criteria, correction log and independently reproducible output. Valid evidence-based refusal can earn full credit; no claimed empirical control-effectiveness probability.
